added_comments.text: Non-ISO shapes some partners send; ISO 8601 (incl. offsets, 'Z', compact basic format and any fractional precision) goes through fromisoformat.

rationale: The agent removed the _clean() string-mangling and the _KNOWN_FORMATS workaround entirely, replacing them with datetime.fromisoformat() as the primary parser (which natively handles offsets, 'Z', and arbitrary fractional precision) plus a small fallback list for genuinely non-ISO partner formats — this addresses the whole class of malformed-offset/precision bugs, not just the Acme case. The Globex end-of-day special-casing (_globex_end_of_day, MSA §4.2) is untouched and still checked before generic parsing, so the protected behavior is preserved.
